Hymn 67: Glory to God on High
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Felice de Giardini

Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 67 titled "Glory to God on High" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Felice de Giardini and the lyrics were written by James Allen.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
